summary: Iterazione 22 (Document Understanding Engine) backend testing COMPLETE. All 26 new Iter22 unit tests PASS (10 classification, 4 resolved_fields, 6 priority/anti-hallucination, 2 confidence, 2 retrocompat, 1 extensibility, 1 unknown->generic). Full regression on Iter19 (17/17) + Iter20 (10/10) + Iter21 (14/14 insights + 9/9 bugfix-router-crash) all green when run standalone: 50/50 legacy document tests. New live-smoke suite hits public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for ticket/invoice/contract + env-threshold module constants: 4/4 PASS. All anti-hallucination rules verified end-to-end: TktID never becomes order_number (routed to technical_identifiers.flat), Posto Unico/Tribuna Rossa/Platea Sinistra never become persons, bare 11-digit sequences never become tax_ids, Data ordine never overrides Data evento, no value appears in two resolved_fields, generic fallback used when nothing exceeds threshold. Iter21 legacy payload keys (summary/entities/extraction/technical_metadata/history/content) 100% preserved. Deterministic pipeline confirmed — no LLM invoked on insights path.

minor.issue: Pre-existing test isolation issue with pytest-xdist: module-scoped `user` fixture uses live-ingress HTTP (requests, not TestClient); when xdist splits TestDocumentsAPI and TestMemoryAskRegression across workers (gw0/gw1), the second worker instantiates its own `user` fixture with no uploaded docs, so /api/memory/ask returns 0 doc sources. Confirmed by re-running with `-o addopts=` (no xdist): 9/9 pass. NOT an Iter22 regression. Recommend either module-level ordering hint (@pytest.mark.dependency or xdist_group) or merging the two classes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter22 Document Understanding Engine is production-ready. Deterministic pipeline verified (no LLM on insights). Anti-hallucination guards hold across 6 dedicated tests + live smoke. Iter19/20/21 fully backward-compat. Known cosmetic: field_resolver exports `HIDDEN_LOWER` (not `HIDDEN_LOWER_THRESHOLD`) — env var name follows the *_THRESHOLD convention but the Python constant is shortened. Known pre-existing infra flake: test_iter21_bugfix_router_crash.py's TestMemoryAskRegression fails under pytest-xdist due to worker isolation of its live-ingress module-scoped `user` fixture; workaround: run with `-o addopts=` (no xdist), or mark both classes with @pytest.mark.xdist_group. When running the entire /app/backend/tests/ dir together, the pre-existing Motor + TestClient 'event loop is closed' infra issue (documented in conftest.py + iteration_17.json) will still appear across unrelated modules — NOT caused by Iter22.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in Iter22 scope. The single failure surfaced (test_ask_cites_document) is a pytest-xdist worker-isolation issue in the test file itself, orthogonal to Iter22. Root cause: TestDocumentsAPI uploads docs into a module-scoped `user` fixture; TestMemoryAskRegression asserts those docs are cited. Under xdist load-scheduling with class distribution, gw1 creates its own instance of the module (and thus a fresh `user` with no uploads), so the assertion fails deterministically. Mitigation: mark the classes with the same xdist_group, or merge them, or force serial execution for that file.
